mods.name: Native USB Names
mods.author: NachoCasta
mods.summary: Show USB volume labels when no rekordbox device name is set.
mods.description: The XDJ-AZ can show a generic USB1 or USB2 name when a USB drive has no device name configured in rekordbox. Native USB Names uses the drive's filesystem volume label instead, making unnamed drives easier to identify. A valid rekordbox device name always takes priority and keeps its original case. If neither name is usable, the native USB1/USB2 fallback remains. Changes display names only: no disk renaming or library changes. Native icons, colors and USB identities are preserved; USB Hub Support is not required.

mods.name: USB Hub Support
mods.author: NachoCasta
mods.summary: USB hubs with startup recovery and reliable touch eject fallback.
mods.description: Connect up to eight USB sticks through a hub, including HFS+ exports. Hubs recover at power-on. USB numbers follow hub ports; native sources appear first, then hub sources in numeric order. Shows rekordbox names/colors and waveforms. Press USB STOP to select a stick or hold to eject the hub; wait for confirmation. If knob input stops, use touch controls without restarting. Experimental Ethernet sharing; actual CDJs and Wi-Fi sharing remain unvalidated. Large libraries may exceed sharing limits. Exact firmware ep147-9e9454e357389ece, kernel4.4.194; core>=1.2.3.
